title: Consistent Saddle Color
description: Changes horses, donkeys, mules, skeleton and zombie horses and camel husks saddles to orange for better consistency
body:
This Resource Pack changes the color palette of horses, donkeys, mules, skeleton and zombie horses and camel husks saddles to orange for better consistency with other saddles from other mobs, like pigs, striders, camels, ravagers and nautilus and nautilus zombie.

Also fixed holes in the model from zombie horse and changed the broken appearance saddle texture to look like the other ones (like in 1.21.11)

# Compatibility
- From 1.21 to 26.2 Vanilla
- Camel husk from [Barched](https://modrinth.com/mod/barched) for 1.21.1
  - Zombie horse still uses the old texture (prior to 1.21.11)
- Compatibility with newer versions and other mods!

# Maybe happy ghasts too?
